title: November Observability release notes link to an unavailable edition guide
problem: The host-based Essentials and Premier release row links to a document path that returned HTTP 404 during this review. The release row provides its own scope. The linked guide could not be used to confirm exact limits or subscription scope.

exclusions: Exact subscription terms, customer authorization and broader release applicability remain unverified.

impact.customerScenario: A reader compares the host-based Essentials and Premier plans using the detail link in the release notes.
impact.consequence: The linked detail page did not provide a basis for verifying exact plan limits or subscription-specific scope.

confidence.rationale: The release-note anchor and exact direct HTTP 404 were observed. Other public access routes and the scope of the document itself remain unknown.

lifecycle.reason: The exact public source leaves a material qualification to verify.

evidence.section: What’s new > Splunk Observability Cloud editions
evidence.statement: The release gives both editions Observability Logs, AI-assisted troubleshooting and Agent Observability. Premier adds named capabilities and a higher monthly span allowance. Exact limits, offering-specific authorization and entitlement require separate sources. The linked edition guide was not retrievable in this run.

documentRevision.qualification: Exact public response bytes; publisher revision unknown.
